metadata.description: Reusable Copilot agents, skills, and engineering workflow plugins.

plugins.name: soft-factory-agents
plugins.description: Soft Factory engineering pipeline agents: RPIV (Research, Plan, Implement, Verify), plus bootstrap, onboarding, issue generation, and the Agnostic Prompt Standard generator.

plugins.name: soft-factory-skills
plugins.description: Soft Factory skills: RPIV (rpiv, rpiv-research, rpiv-planner, rpiv-implementer, rpiv-verifier) plus bootstrap, onboard-repo, issue-generator, excali, harness-cli-it, and the Agnostic Prompt Standard, with shared templates.

plugins.name: soft-factory-extras
plugins.description: Extra Soft Factory agents and skills. Includes the deep-research orchestrator that runs an Exa-powered, Microsoft-preferring research pipeline, the prd-to-gh-issues agent that turns a PRD into a linked GitHub issue backlog, and the pr-review-complement skill.

plugins.name: visual-explainer
plugins.description: Generate self-contained HTML pages for diagrams, diff/plan reviews, project recaps, comparison tables, and slide decks.
